mapper.insert: insert into booknest.`chat_conversation`(id, user1_id, user2_id, last_message, last_msg_at, create_time) values (#{id}, #{user1Id}, #{user2Id}, #{lastMessage}, #{lastMsgAt}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from booknest.`chat_conversation` where user1_id = #{user1Id} and user2_id = #{user2Id}
select * from booknest.`chat_conversation` where user1_id = #{userId} or user2_id = #{userId} order by last_msg_at desc
mapper.update: update booknest.`chat_conversation` set last_message = #{lastMessage}, last_msg_at = #{lastMsgAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into booknest.`chat_message`(id, conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, group_id, content, msg_type, is_read, create_time) values (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{groupId}, #{content}, #{msgType}, #{isRead}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from booknest.`chat_message` where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by create_time desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from booknest.`chat_message` where receiver_id = #{receiverId} and is_read = 0
select count(*) from booknest.`chat_message` where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} and is_read = 0
select conversation_id as conversationId, count(*) as unreadCount from booknest.`chat_message` where receiver_id = #{receiverId} and is_read = 0 group by conversation_id
mapper.update: update booknest.`chat_message` set is_read = 1 where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} and is_read = 0
